name: Update UCDP attacks by Israel map

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: "40 13 * * 2"

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  update:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install requests beautifulsoup4

      - name: Build UCDP attacks-by-Israel timeline
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import csv, io, json, re, zipfile
          from datetime import datetime, timezone
          from pathlib import Path
          from urllib.parse import urljoin
          import requests
          from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

          START = "2023-10-07"
          DOWNLOADS = "https://ucdp.uu.se/downloads/"
          GED_FALLBACK = "https://ucdp.uu.se/downloads/ged/ged261-csv.zip"
          CANDIDATE_FALLBACK = "https://ucdp.uu.se/downloads/candidateged/GEDEvent_v26_01_26_06.csv"

          session = requests.Session()
          session.headers.update({
              "User-Agent": "GazaTimeline-UCDP/6.0",
              "Accept": "*/*",
          })

          ACTOR = (
              r"(?:Israeli\s+(?:forces?|military|army|troops?|soldiers?|air\s*force|"
              r"aircraft|warplanes?|jets?|drones?|navy|artillery)|"
              r"Israel(?:'s)?\s+(?:forces?|military|army|air\s*force|aircraft|"
              r"warplanes?|jets?|drones?|navy|artillery)|IDF)"
          )
          ACTION = (
              r"(?:attack(?:ed|s|ing)?|strike|strikes|struck|bomb(?:ed|ing|s)?|"
              r"bombard(?:ed|ment|ments|ing)?|shell(?:ed|ing|s)?|raid(?:ed|s|ing)?|"
              r"shot|shoot(?:s|ing)?|fire(?:d|s|ing)?\s+(?:at|on|toward|towards)|"
              r"launched?\s+(?:a\s+)?(?:missile|missiles|strike|strikes|attack|attacks)|"
              r"carried\s+out\s+(?:a\s+)?(?:strike|attack|raid|bombardment)|"
              r"conducted\s+(?:a\s+)?(?:strike|attack|raid|bombardment))"
          )

          ACTIVE = re.compile(rf"\b{ACTOR}\b.{{0,160}}\b{ACTION}\b", re.I | re.S)
          PASSIVE = re.compile(
              rf"\b(?:attacked|struck|bombed|bombarded|shelled|raided|shot)\b"
              rf".{{0,110}}\bby\s+{ACTOR}\b",
              re.I | re.S,
          )
          ATTRIBUTED_NOUN = re.compile(
              r"\b(?:Israeli|Israel(?:'s)?|IDF)\s+"
              r"(?:air[\s-]?strike|air[\s-]?raid|drone[\s-]?strike|"
              r"artillery\s+(?:strike|shelling)|missile\s+strike|"
              r"naval\s+(?:strike|shelling)|military\s+strike|"
              r"bombardment|shelling|raid|attack)s?\b",
              re.I,
          )
          TARGET_ISRAEL = re.compile(
              r"\b(?:attack(?:ed|s|ing)?|strike|strikes|struck|"
              r"rocket(?:s)?\s+(?:at|toward|towards)|"
              r"missile(?:s)?\s+(?:at|toward|towards)|"
              r"fire(?:d)?\s+(?:at|toward|towards))\s+"
              r"(?:on\s+|against\s+|at\s+|toward\s+|towards\s+)?"
              r"(?:Israel|Israeli\s+(?:territory|forces?|soldiers?|towns?|cities|communities))\b",
              re.I,
          )

          def get(url, timeout=180):
              r = session.get(url, timeout=timeout)
              r.raise_for_status()
              return r

          def discover():
              ged = GED_FALLBACK
              candidate = CANDIDATE_FALLBACK
              try:
                  soup = BeautifulSoup(get(DOWNLOADS, 90).text, "html.parser")
                  for a in soup.find_all("a", href=True):
                      href = urljoin(DOWNLOADS, a["href"])
                      low = href.lower()
                      if re.search(r"/downloads/ged/ged261-csv\.zip$", low):
                          ged = href
                      if re.search(r"/downloads/candidateged/gedevent_v26_01_26_06\.csv$", low):
                          candidate = href
              except Exception as e:
                  print("WARNING download-page discovery failed; using fallback URLs:", e)
              return ged, candidate

          def decode(data):
              for enc in ("utf-8-sig", "utf-8", "latin-1"):
                  try:
                      return data.decode(enc)
                  except UnicodeDecodeError:
                      pass
              return data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")

          def rows_from_csv(data):
              text = decode(data)
              try:
                  dialect = csv.Sniffer().sniff(text[:10000], delimiters=",;\t")
              except Exception:
                  dialect = csv.excel
              return list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(text), dialect=dialect))

          def load_ged(url):
              with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(get(url).content)) as z:
                  names = [n for n in z.namelist() if n.lower().endswith(".csv") and not n.startswith("__MACOSX")]
                  if not names:
                      raise RuntimeError("No CSV in GED ZIP")
                  names.sort(key=lambda n: z.getinfo(n).file_size, reverse=True)
                  print("GED CSV:", names[0])
                  return rows_from_csv(z.read(names[0]))

          def first(row, *names):
              for name in names:
                  v = row.get(name)
                  if v not in (None, ""):
                      return v
              lookup = {str(k).lower(): v for k, v in row.items()}
              for name in names:
                  v = lookup.get(name.lower())
                  if v not in (None, ""):
                      return v
              return None

          def num(v, default=None):
              try:
                  return float(v)
              except Exception:
                  return default

          def integer(v, default=0):
              try:
                  return int(float(v))
              except Exception:
                  return default

          def event_date(row):
              raw = str(first(row, "date_start", "date", "date_end") or "")
              m = re.search(r"\b20\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2}\b", raw)
              if m:
                  return m.group(0)
              m = re.search(r"\b(\d{1,2})/(\d{1,2})/(20\d{2})\b", raw)
              if m:
                  return f"{m.group(3)}-{int(m.group(2)):02d}-{int(m.group(1)):02d}"
              return None

          def actor_related(row):
              text = " | ".join(str(first(row, f) or "") for f in (
                  "side_a", "side_b", "dyad_name", "conflict_name"
              ))
              return bool(re.search(r"\bGovernment of Israel\b", text, re.I))

          def metadata(row):
              return " | ".join(str(first(row, f) or "") for f in (
                  "source_article", "source_headline", "source_original", "where_description"
              ))

          def explicitly_by_israel(row):
              text = metadata(row)
              positive = bool(ACTIVE.search(text) or PASSIVE.search(text) or ATTRIBUTED_NOUN.search(text))
              if not positive:
                  return False
              if TARGET_ISRAEL.search(text):
                  return False
              return True

          def normalize(row, dataset):
              lat = num(first(row, "latitude", "lat"))
              lon = num(first(row, "longitude", "lon"))
              date = event_date(row)
              if lat is None or lon is None or not date:
                  return None
              return {
                  "id": str(first(row, "id") or ""),
                  "relid": first(row, "relid"),
                  "date": date,
                  "date_end": first(row, "date_end"),
                  "lat": lat,
                  "lon": lon,
                  "location": first(row, "where_coordinates") or first(row, "where_description"),
                  "country": first(row, "country"),
                  "where_prec": integer(first(row, "where_prec"), None),
                  "date_prec": integer(first(row, "date_prec"), None),
                  "side_a": first(row, "side_a"),
                  "side_b": first(row, "side_b"),
                  "dataset": dataset,
              }

          def classify(rows, label, minimum_date, maximum_date=None):
              israel_related = 0
              explicit = 0
              mapped = []
              newest_input = newest_israel = newest_explicit = None

              for row in rows:
                  date = event_date(row)
                  if not date:
                      continue
                  newest_input = max(newest_input, date) if newest_input else date

                  if date < minimum_date:
                      continue
                  if maximum_date and date > maximum_date:
                      continue
                  if not actor_related(row):
                      continue

                  israel_related += 1
                  newest_israel = max(newest_israel, date) if newest_israel else date

                  if not explicitly_by_israel(row):
                      continue

                  explicit += 1
                  newest_explicit = max(newest_explicit, date) if newest_explicit else date
                  item = normalize(row, label)
                  if item:
                      mapped.append(item)

              print()
              print(f"=== {label} DIAGNOSTICS ===")
              print("Rows loaded:", len(rows))
              print("Newest date in source:", newest_input)
              print("Israel-related events:", israel_related)
              print("Newest Israel-related event:", newest_israel)
              print("Explicit attacks BY Israel:", explicit)
              print("Newest accepted attack BY Israel:", newest_explicit)
              print("Mapped rows:", len(mapped))
              return mapped

          ged_url, candidate_url = discover()
          print("GED download:", ged_url)
          print("Cumulative Candidate 2026 download:", candidate_url)

          ged_rows = load_ged(ged_url)
          candidate_rows = rows_from_csv(get(candidate_url).content)

          print()
          print("=== DOWNLOAD DIAGNOSTICS ===")
          print("GED records loaded:", len(ged_rows))
          print("Candidate 2026 records loaded:", len(candidate_rows))

          ged_events = classify(ged_rows, "UCDP GED 26.1", START, "2025-12-31")
          candidate_events = classify(
              candidate_rows,
              "UCDP Candidate 26.01.26.06",
              "2026-01-01",
              None,
          )

          merged = {}
          for item in ged_events + candidate_events:
              key = item.get("relid") or (
                  f"{item['date']}|{item['lat']:.5f}|{item['lon']:.5f}|"
                  f"{item.get('side_a')}|{item.get('side_b')}"
              )
              merged[key] = item

          events = sorted(
              merged.values(),
              key=lambda e: (e["date"], e.get("relid") or "", e.get("id") or "")
          )

          if not events:
              raise RuntimeError("No strict attacks-by-Israel events produced.")

          newest_ged = max((e["date"] for e in ged_events), default=None)
          newest_candidate = max((e["date"] for e in candidate_events), default=None)
          newest_raw_candidate = max(
              (event_date(r) for r in candidate_rows if event_date(r)),
              default=None,
          )

          print()
          print("=== FINAL MAP DIAGNOSTICS ===")
          print("Accepted GED events:", len(ged_events))
          print("Accepted Candidate 2026 events:", len(candidate_events))
          print("Newest accepted GED event:", newest_ged)
          print("Newest accepted Candidate event:", newest_candidate)
          print("Newest date in raw Candidate file:", newest_raw_candidate)
          print("Final deduplicated map events:", len(events))
          print("Newest mapped Israeli attack:", events[-1]["date"])

          if newest_raw_candidate and newest_raw_candidate >= "2026-06-01" and newest_candidate is None:
              print(
                  "WARNING: The Candidate file contains June 2026 events, "
                  "but none passed the strict attacks-by-Israel classifier."
              )

          output = {
              "source": "Uppsala Conflict Data Program (UCDP) public downloads",
              "license": "CC BY 4.0",
              "generated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
              "start_date": START,
              "ged_download": ged_url,
              "candidate_download": candidate_url,
              "candidate_version": "26.01.26.06",
              "method": {
                  "direction": "Only UCDP records whose text explicitly attributes the attack to Israeli/IDF forces are retained.",
                  "target_exclusion": "Records clearly describing Israel as the target are rejected.",
                  "warning": "UCDP has no universal event-level attacker field; ambiguous events are omitted."
              },
              "diagnostics": {
                  "ged_records_loaded": len(ged_rows),
                  "candidate_records_loaded": len(candidate_rows),
                  "accepted_ged_events": len(ged_events),
                  "accepted_candidate_events": len(candidate_events),
                  "newest_accepted_ged_event": newest_ged,
                  "newest_accepted_candidate_event": newest_candidate,
                  "newest_raw_candidate_date": newest_raw_candidate,
                  "newest_mapped_event": events[-1]["date"],
              },
              "events": events,
          }

          Path("data").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
          Path("data/ucdp-attacks.json").write_text(
              json.dumps(output, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")),
              encoding="utf-8",
          )

          print()
          print(
              f"SUCCESS: {len(events)} strict attacks by Israel, "
              f"{events[0]['date']} through {events[-1]['date']}"
          )
          PY

      - name: Commit map data
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add data/ucdp-attacks.json
          git diff --cached --quiet && exit 0
          git commit -m "Update UCDP attacks-by-Israel map"
          git push
